title: Ears without gold, gold without ears
odia:
କାନ ଥିଲେ ସୁନା ନାଇଁ
ସୁନା ଥିଲେ କାନ ନାଇଁ।
literal_meaning: When there are ears, there is no gold; when there is gold, there are no ears.
meaning_odia: ଇଚ୍ଛା ଥିବାବେଳେ ସମ୍ବଳ ନାହିଁ, ଆଉ ସମ୍ବଳ ଥିବାବେଳେ ଇଚ୍ଛା ନାହିଁ—ଦୁଇଟି ଏକାଠି ନମିଳିବାର କଥା। କାନ ଓ ସୁନାର ଏହି ଓଲଟା ଯୋଡ଼ାରେ ଦରକାରୀ ଦୁଇ ପଟରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ସବୁବେଳେ ଅଭାବ ରହୁଛି।
explanation: Two things that would serve each other fail to arrive together. The inspected source explains the contrast as having the desire without the money, then the money without the desire. The repeated reversal gives that mismatch a rueful, memorable form.
usage_example: Someone long wanted to learn an expensive hobby but could not afford it; years later, the money is available and the interest has faded. They recall this saying. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The pairing evokes gold worn at the ear. Each line supplies one half and withdraws the other, so the value of having either is frustrated by the absence of its counterpart.

witnesses.locator: Page10, two-line saying beginning କାନ ଥିଲେ.
witnesses.note: Rendered page inspected17November2026; uploaded ନାଇଁ retained twice.
Variant has ନାହିଁ twice. Explicit gloss compares wealth without desire and desire without wealth.

variants.odia:
ଦାନ୍ତ ବେଳକୁ ଚଣା ନାଇଁ
ଚଣା ବେଳକୁ ଦାନ୍ତ ନାଇଁ।
variants.note: Related alternate expression grouped editorially with the ears/gold reversal; replaces adornment/desire with eating/physical capacity. No established textual descent. Literal: When there are teeth, there are no chickpeas; when there are chickpeas, there are no teeth. ଅର୍ଥ: ଦାନ୍ତ ଥିବାବେଳେ ଚଣା ମିଳୁନାହିଁ, ଆଉ ଚଣା ମିଳିବାବେଳେ ଦାନ୍ତ ନାହିଁ। ଯାହାକୁ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଛୁ ଓ ତାହା କରିବାର ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟ ଏକ ସମୟରେ ନମିଳିବାର ଆକ୍ଷେପ ଏଥିରେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି। Explanation: The two lines exchange what is present and absent. Food and the means of chewing it fail to coincide. This is a concrete counterpart to the ears/gold reversal: it changes adornment and desire to eating and physical capacity. No particular person’s ageing or financial history is stated. Source: uploaded compilation page24, inspected17November2026; exact ନାଇଁ retained.
